body.x: Standard Energy (CEO Bu-gi Kim) participated in the CES 2023 held in Las Vegas, USA, at the 'Seoul Tech Pavilion' in the Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC) for a total of 4 days from January 5 (Thursday) to January 8 (Sunday, local time).

Standard Energy, which took its first step in August 2013, is a start-up company established by KAIST researchers who focused on developing and manufacturing battery-based ESS. In April 2020, Standard Energy introduced the world's first Vanadium Ion Battery which attracted investments worth 95 billion KRW on a cumulative basis from SoftBank Ventures in 2021 and LOTTE Chemical in 2022. In 2021, they were selected as ‘Technology Pioneer 2021’ by the World Economic Forum (WEF). Since May 2022, they have operated Charger5, a super-fast EV charging station linked to Vanadium Ion Battery ESS, in Seoul. From 2023, they plan to start mass production and commercialization of Vanadium Ion Battery ESS as well as to diversify its applications.

Vanadium Ion Battery is a stationary battery specialized for energy storage devices (ESS). An official explains that it is a new battery created by a completely different technology from lithium-ion batteries, which are widely used as mobile batteries, or vanadium redox flow batteries, which have the same vanadium as the main component.

For the Vanadium Ion Battery manufactured based on the water-based liquid electrode, Standard Energy explained that it has virtually no risk of self-heating, ignition, and thermal runaway and is not sensitive to external temperature conditions. In addition, unlike conventional batteries that show capacity deterioration when continuously charged and discharged, Vanadium Ion Batteries are known to maintain a stable capacity of more than 95% despite 10,000 cycles of continuous charge and discharge (DOD: 100%) test.
Vanadium Ion Battery also has the highest level of energy efficiency (97%), and the ESS unit also shows energy efficiency in the mid-90% range.
Through this, various applications of Vanadium Ion Battery ESS can be used in △Renewable energy storage devices △C&I peak shaving △High-speed EV charging power supply △Ship ESS solutions.

Standard Energy has successfully completed the production and operation of prototypes of ESS based on Vanadium Ion Batteries and is currently preparing to launch commercial products. They plan to install Vanadium Ion Battery ESS for EV charging stations in E1 and LPG charging stations and are also collaborating with Hyundai Heavy Industries to develop ESS solutions for ships. In addition, they are planning a low-carbon power trading business and a solar energy-linked RE100 business.

Meanwhile, 'CES', the world's largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition where you can grasp the trend of the global home appliance industry at a glance. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held in Las Vegas, USA every January. AVING News, which has covered CES for 17 consecutive years, has reported CES news all over the world every year since 2006. AVING NEWS also holds 'BEST OF CES', which selects the best innovative products and technologies, and 'BEST OF MADE IN KOREA', which selects Korean innovative companies. In addition, through ‘AVING LIVE’, CES site have been streamed in real time.

The Seoul Technology Pavilion operated a Theme Zone which implemented elements of visions for the future and elements for experiences, as well as a Tech Zone which displayed the innovative technology of partnered large corporations and startups. The Seoul Business Agency (SBA) showcased the Seoul Technology Pavilion’s innovative technology in the field of ‘mobility and ESG’ in a large corporation connected open innovation method, and 7 startups possessing innovative technology in the relevant fields will be in participation.
